summary: Short kerb by a junction; homes 12-13 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12-13 m behind the kerb, more across the road; no buffer of bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; the kerb is short and close to a junction, so a van needs care to sit clear.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street and side street, light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park nearby, but no camping convention.

sun_shade: Mostly open; a large tree shades the west end.
cannot_judge: Whether junction sight lines make parking here awkward

best_section.where: Disraeli Street north kerb, just before the side-street corner
